assets.altText: Four adult women in metallic couture link hands at a guarded overlook above the Danube winding through Đerdap Gorge; the dark-haired woman on the right kisses the blonde woman's cheek.

Four adult women in short, opaque metallic cocktail looks link hands at a guarded overlook above the Danube and Đerdap Gorge while the dark-haired woman on the right kisses the smiling blonde woman's cheek.
Four adult women in jewel-toned futuristic outfits embrace on a rocky Kopaonik plateau with layered forested mountain ridges beneath a sunset sky.

Four adult women in metallic party outfits hold hands before the red earth pyramids of Đavolja Varoš at sunset; the Black woman kisses the brunette woman's cheek.
